metrics: Full-lifecycle all-arrival cohort TPOT/TTFT; fixed-window output-only throughput; actual execution GPU-seconds divided by actual output tokens, window and lifecycle separately; CPU timings reported separately from simulated time.

independent_review: Unavailable; deterministic checks are not external review.
